{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|Fortunately, Expansionary Fleet vessels are equipped with more powerful transmitters than those of the regular Defense Fleet forces, since we seldom have a normal colony system's network of boosters and repeaters to draw on.|[[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]|<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
An '''anchor-point network''' was a network of<ref name="Gamer 5">{{GamerCite|5|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Chiss}}</ref> [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|navigational anchor-points]]<ref name="FF137">{{FactFile|137|CHI 1-4|Chiss}}</ref> used by the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] to travel through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] within the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] Space of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Chiss vessels thus lack the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] and were unable to safely travel beyond the Chiss borders. The Chiss waited decades for the completion of the network before they left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]].<ref name="Gamer 5" />
